recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce the older 8287-5/59408-5 details or a separate body-length profile unless a new OO work-group decision changes the current R6 vital-sign profile model.
issue_request: FHIR-12246 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for FHIR-core Observation, raised in DSTU2, to align the core Observation Vital Signs profiles with the US-Core vital-sign profile. The disposition asked to replace Argonaut, DAF, and US-Core profile references with core resource links and listed specific vital-sign changes, including oxygen saturation, body length, head circumference, and removing mean blood pressure from the mandatory profile set.
initial_application: Historical commits 0d2d645db323246e3c7f844058f4fbf4dcbf62a9, 00682120489c039f986a06f735a6d98f9ffe20d9, and 7f5590e232fecd512aa73c548d18d6b69282ad8d pre-applied the seed by rewriting the old vital-sign profile introduction/spreadsheet, using core resource references such as Reference(Patient), adding examples/profile material including body length, and adjusting cardinality. Later source refactors carried the vital-sign definitions into current XML StructureDefinition and ImplementationGuide inputs.
additional_context: FHIR-17394 later changed the head-circumference and oxygen-saturation magic-value codes back to methodless LOINC codes 9843-4 and 2708-6, superseding the seed's method-specific code details. FHIR-17540 later removed the separate Body Length 8306-3 line item and made body length an additional code under the methodless Body Height profile. FHIR-46418 reworked the R6 vital-sign profiles so Observation.code holds the actual vital-sign code with profile-specific preferred value sets; the current Body Height profile and value set explicitly include body length. FHIR-11989 and duplicate FHIR-12233 provide the surrounding DAF/US-Core alignment background. The remaining Argonaut/DAF link is a historical provenance note, not an active profile constraint.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current build-scoped source has Observation active in source/fhir.ini, the vitalsigns ImplementationGuide references the current profile StructureDefinitions, Observation.subject targets the core Patient resource, oxygen saturation and head circumference use later-approved methodless codes, and body length is represented through the bodyheight profile/value set and example.
